profile.observed: The main tokenzero thread was blocked in child wait_timeout while dedicated tokenzero-runtime workers drained stdout/stderr with capture_reader; no cargo/compiler process appears in the sample.

root_causes.name: large payload sidecar hashing duplicated the canonical digest
root_causes.baseline_evidence: crates/tokenzero-recovery/src/lib.rs:1394 computed the canonical SHA-256, then the old externalize_blob_value implementation recomputed SHA-256 over the same multi-MiB text before writing its sidecar.
root_causes.fix: crates/tokenzero-recovery/src/lib.rs:1430 passes full_hash into externalize_blob_value; line 2465 accepts the proven digest and no longer scans the payload again.

root_causes.name: shell capture telemetry rehashed three already-addressed buffers
root_causes.baseline_evidence: crates/tokenzero-mcp/src/engine_shell.rs:131-151 stored stdout, stderr, and combined output through RecoveryStore (which hashes each at tokenzero-recovery/src/lib.rs:1394), then old lines 179, 190, and 197 called sha256_hex over the same buffers again solely for telemetry.
root_causes.fix: crates/tokenzero-mcp/src/engine_shell.rs:179,190,197 derives telemetry SHA-256 from the canonical tz://blob/<sha256> refs returned by storage.

ruled_out: Compiler noise: the committed harness invokes the prebuilt target/debug/tokenzero and no cargo/rustc appears in the process sample.
Unbounded capture: tokenzero-runtime capture_reader is policy-bounded and spills excess output; the representative 5 MiB capture remains below its configured limit.
Whole-cache snapshot rewrite on every persist: current RecoveryStore::persist uses the journal delta fast path at crates/tokenzero-recovery/src/lib.rs:1702-1727; no benchmark-only branch was added.
